description: The line plot illustrates how the loss ratio (%) varies with computational cost, measured in TFLOPs, across five different model configurations. The x-axis, labeled “TFLOPs,” uses a custom logarithmic-like scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick marks placed at irregular intervals: 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis, labeled “Loss Ratio (%)”, spans from 94% to 100% on a linear scale, with major gridlines and labels every 1 percentage point. Five distinct lines are plotted: the purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers and a solid line style, labeled “Vanilla,” remains flat at 100% across all TFLOP values. The orange line with horizontal line markers, “SepLLM (n=64),” begins near 98.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to approximately 100.5% around 4e8 TFLOPs, and then fluctuates slightly before settling near 100% at 9e8. The blue line with cross markers, “SepLLM (n=128),” starts at about 97.0% at 1e7 TFLOPs and gradually increases to roughly 99.8% by 9e8 TFLOPs. The green line with diamond markers, “SepLLM (n=64, H),” begins at approximately 97.5%, climbs to a peak of about 100.2% near 4e8 TFLOPs, and then stabilizes around 99.8% toward the end. The red line with circular markers, “SepLLM (n=64, H/T),” starts at 94.0% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to a peak of approximately 99.0% near 4e8 TFLOPs, and then declines to about 98.7% at 9e8 TFLOPs. A legend in the bottom-right corner identifies each line by name and visual style.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the relationship between computational power, measured in TFLOPs, and loss ratio in percentage. The x-axis represents TFLOPs and has a custom scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick marks labeled at intervals like 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the loss ratio in percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 94% to 100%, marked at regular intervals of 1. Five lines are depicted in this plot. The purple line with triangle markers and a solid style represents the 'Vanilla' method, which remains constant at 100% across the x-axis. The orange line with line markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64)' and increases from approximately 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs to around 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs, peaking at 102% near 4e8. The blue line with cross markers depicts 'SepLLM (n=128)', starting at about 97% and ending at 99%, with a steady increase. The green line with diamond markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' and follows a similar pattern, beginning at approximately 97.5% and peaking at 101% before stabilizing at 99%. The red line with round markers shows 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)', starting at 94%, peaking at around 98% near 4e8 TFLOPs, and declining to 96% near the end of the x-axis. A legend is given at the bottom right.
